<script>
    $(function(){
        $("img.lazy").lazyload({
            threshold : 200,
            effect : "fadeIn"
        });

        $("#efoxlinkchat").click(function(){
            $("#efoxchat_arror").toggleClass("chat_down");
            $(this).toggleClass("nobtmborder");
            $(".efoxtpchatinfo").fadeToggle();
        })
    });

    function getQueryString(name) {  
        var reg = new RegExp("(^|&)" + name + "=([^&]*)(&|$)", "i");  
        var r = location.search.substr(1).match(reg);  
        if (r != null) return unescape(decodeURI(r[2])); return '';  
    }

    var oldurl=window.location.href;
    var newurl='';
    var currencyval=getQueryString('currency');
    var isquery=0;
    if(oldurl.indexOf("?") >= 0 ){  
        isquery=1;
    }

    function getCurrencyUrl(currency){
        strs=oldurl.split("#");
        oldurl=strs[0];
        if(currencyval!=''){
            newurl=oldurl.replace('currency='+currencyval,'currency='+currency);
        }else{
            if(isquery==0){
                newurl=oldurl+'?currency='+currency;
            }else{
                newurl=oldurl+'&currency='+currency;    
            }   
        }
        window.location.href=newurl;
    }

    $(document).on('click', '.search_keyword_input', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var input_val = $(this).val();
        $(".search_keyword_input").val(input_val);
        get_keywords_prompt(input_val);
    });
      
    $(document).on('propertychange input', '.search_keyword_input', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var input_val = $(this).val();
        $(".search_keyword_input").val(input_val);
        get_keywords_prompt(input_val);
    });

    function get_keywords_prompt(input_val){
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST",
            dataType: 'JSON',
            url: "/goods/ajax/get_keywords_prompt",
            data: {'keywords': input_val},
            success:function(res){
                if(res.error){
                    $(".keywordsPrompt").hide();
                }else{
                    $(".keywordsPrompt").html(res.content);
                    $(".keywordsPrompt").show();
                }   
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).on('click', '.keywordsPrompt a',  function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var input_val = $(this).text();
        $(".search_keyword_input").val(input_val);
        $(".search-btn").trigger("click");
    });

    $(document).on('mouseleave', '.keywordsPrompt',  function(e){
        $(".keywordsPrompt").hide();
    });

    $(document).on('keyup', '.search_keyword_input',  function(e){
        if (e.keyCode == "13") {
            $(".search-btn").trigger("click");
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', 'button.search-btn',  function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var search_string = $.trim($(this).closest(".searchForm").find('.search_keyword_input').val());
        if (search_string != '' && search_string.toLowerCase() != 'search') {
            search_string = search_string.replace(/\ +/g, '-');
            var cat_item_val = $(this).closest(".searchForm").find(".dropdown-item.cat-item.active").text();
            if(cat_item_val){
                cat_item_val = cat_item_val.replace(/\s/g,"-");
                window.location.href = "/s/"+ cat_item_val+ "/" +search_string;
            }else{
                window.location.href = "/s/"+search_string;
            }
        }
    });

    if($('#cookie-tip-show').length){
        $('.cookie-tip-bg').css('display','block');
    }
    $('.cookie-tip-btn').click(function(){
        $('.cookie-tip-bg').css('display','none');
        $.ajax({
            url: '/user/member/ajaxCookie',
            type: 'get',
            success: function(data) {
                console.log(data);
            }
        });
    });
</script>
